cards.title: ECHO-OFTRL Algorithm Achieves Constant Individual Regret in N-Player Games, Removing Polylogarithmic Horizon Dependence
cards.why_it_matters: For RL and multi-agent systems researchers, eliminating the horizon dependence in individual regret is a theoretical milestone relevant to designing decentralized equilibrium-finding algorithms.
cards.summary: ECHO-OFTRL combines optimistic follow-the-regularized-leader with an EMA cascade for high-order optimism. For any finite N-player normal-form game under full-information feedback, it guarantees per-player regret bounded by O(poly(N, log m_max)) simultaneously for all horizons T≥1, with no polylogarithmic T factor. The algorithm is deterministic and fully uncoupled.

cards.title: Kuafu System Uses LLM-Synthesized 'SUN Programs' to Unify MPC Control and RL Policy Learning for Robot Manipulation
cards.why_it_matters: Robotics and RL researchers will find this directly relevant: it replaces hand-crafted dense rewards and demonstrations with auto-synthesized semantic programs, achieving strong sim-to-real transfer.
cards.summary: Semantically UNified (SUN) Programs encode geometric and contact relations once, compiling them into MPC costs, RL rewards, and transition guards. A vision-language model auto-synthesizes programs from language and scene input. Across nine tasks, Kuafu achieves 82.03% macro-success vs. 35.67% sparse-reward and 24.75% Stage-BC baselines; DP3 policies trained on 500 trajectories reach 34.7% success on physical Franka and Kinova robots.

cards.title: Quantum Circuit Framework Simulates Both Markovian and Non-Markovian Open Quantum Dynamics for Heavy-Ion Physics
cards.why_it_matters: If you follow quantum ML or quantum simulation, this bridges quantum computing methods with nuclear physics by introducing a concrete circuit construction for memory-carrying non-Markovian dynamics.
cards.summary: Authors introduce a pseudomode auxiliary qubit that carries bath memory, coupling to the subsystem and a residual Markovian bath. Tracing out the pseudomode exactly reproduces non-Markovian evolution; in appropriate time-scale limits, the circuit smoothly recovers Markovian behavior. Framework targets future simulation of jets, heavy quarks, and quarkonia in heavy-ion collisions.

cards.title: Context-Aware Interleaved Batching Cuts WhisperX Word Error Rate While Preserving Throughput
cards.why_it_matters: For ML engineers deploying ASR pipelines, this offers a drop-in improvement over WhisperX that recovers cross-segment context without sacrificing batch throughput.
cards.summary: WhisperX batches audio segments in isolation, losing punctuation and terminology context; standard Whisper preserves context but hallucinates. The proposed method uses VAD segment boundaries to stabilize text conditioning, allowing historical context to persist across batches. Long-form audio benchmarks show lower WER and better proper noun accuracy at high throughput.

cards.title: Efficient Analytical Protocol Finds Excitable Zero-Modes in Constrained Quantum Systems via Local Eigendecomposition
cards.why_it_matters: Researchers working on quantum many-body scars, Rydberg atom arrays, or tensor-network methods will find this a useful analytical tool for characterizing atypical eigenstates in constrained Hamiltonians.
cards.summary: The protocol uses eigendecomposition of the local unconstrained Hamiltonian to analytically find translation-invariant excitable zero-modes (EZMs) in kinetically constrained systems. Applied to a decorated Rydberg chain, it produces a continuous MPS manifold in the zero-energy eigenspace whose span grows exponentially with system size, and derives analytical expressions for non-zero-momentum zero-modes and exact scars at E=±√3.

cards.title: Sharp Approximation Rate for Hypernetworks: Latent Dimension M and Network Budget P Trade Off as (P·min{M,P})^{-α/d}
cards.why_it_matters: For researchers studying hypernetworks, LoRA-style adapters, or parameter-efficient fine-tuning, this gives the first sharp theoretical bound characterizing how much expressivity is lost by compressing into a low-dimensional latent space.
cards.summary: For affine generators mapping R^M latent codes to ReLU network parameters with budget P, the optimal worst-case uniform approximation error over α-Hölder functions on [0,1]^d is shown to scale sharply as (P·min{M,P})^{-α/d}. Notably, even a fixed-dimensional latent space suffices for vanishing error as P grows, justifying parameter-efficient methods theoretically.
